notes: Upper cap is also a matched pair: cap-rear behind card, cap-front in front. Both upper layers use IDENTICAL transform/opacity and move as one cap. Never independently centre or animate either half.
shell-cap is now legacy whole-cap reference only; do not draw it alongside cap-rear/cap-front.
Render bowl-rear BEHIND card and bowl-front IN FRONT of card, at exactly the same transform. Cap is separate above during lift.
Without a card, rear + front reconstruct the shared authored bowl within two byte levels on dark, white and magenta backgrounds.
Legacy shell-front is the complete bowl reference; do not use it as the new foreground occluder.
Use common 512x640 canvas and pivot for every frame; do not independently trim/recenter.
Shell pieces are separately authored transparent cutouts; do not slice the combined source, whose haze made an edge under motion.
Open frame is composed from the two final authored pieces at their registered positions.
Source PNGs may contain invisible RGB; use actual alpha when inspecting/compositing.
